OPD Slot Predictor

Enter a booking and get the slot length to book, from a LightGBM model trained on January–June visits. Below the demo: how the model did on July–August, two months it never saw, against today's fixed 15-minute slot.

All visits are simulated (a learning project): the doctors, clinics and patients are invented, and no real patient data was used.

July–August: visits the model never saw

The model was trained on visits from January–June and scored once on July–August. Each row books the model's prediction rounded up to the grid chosen above; "today" books 15 minutes for everyone. Quality

How close to the best possible

The score (pinball loss) charges each late minute q and each idle minute 1 − q, so lower is better. "Best possible" knows the simulator's hidden rule; only random luck is left. The lookup table is the best simple rule (median-style P-point per doctor and visit type).

Where it struggles

Visits on time, by department and for the new doctor

    Before going live

    Limits and next steps

    • Simulated data. The method is real; the numbers are from a simulated hospital. A real deployment retrains on the hospital's EMR export.
    • Changes after training. Dermatology visits got longer from 1 July; the model, trained on January–June, books them too short. Monthly retraining and a drift monitor fix this.
    • New doctors. A doctor with no history gets the department's typical slot until a few weeks of their visits exist, then the model is retrained.
    • The safety level is a business decision. P67, P75 or P80 trades patient waiting against doctor idle time; the product owner picks from the table above.
    • Safe rollout. Run in shadow mode first (predict, compare, don't book), keep 15 minutes as the fallback if the model is unavailable.

    Inputs used, all known at booking time: doctor, department, visit type, clinic, weekday, hour, patient age (or unknown), prior reports, interpreter, video consult. Model: LightGBM with the quantile objective, one model per safety level; chosen over XGBoost and simple lookup tables on June data.

    Built from slotpred/final.py and notes/interactive/build.py. Simulated data; a learning project.
